question: Why are the fission fragments produced during the fission of Uranium-235 almost always radioactive?

options.A: They possess excess protons compared to stable nuclei of that mass.
options.B: They possess a high neutron-to-proton ratio inherited from the parent Uranium.
options.C: They absorb alpha particles during the explosion.
options.D: They are ionized due to high temperatures.
